relationships.subject: carrageenan
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, it was suggested that injection of carrageenan can induce pain aversion.

key_findings: Carrageenan inflammatory pain reduced ACC GABAergic neuron activity; chemogenetic activation of these neurons blocked pain aversion while inhibition induced aversion in naive mice.
0.3 mA (not 0.1 mA) 2/100 Hz EA increased ACC GABA and relieved pain aversion, an effect reversed by chemogenetic inhibition of ACC GABAergic neurons.
